prompt: In my wiki at /tmp/test-wiki/, find the shortest path between the 'authentication' concept and the 'database-schema' concept. Show all intermediate pages.

assertions.text: Runs graph_ops.py (or graph_ops.ts) to query the relationship graph
Returns ordered list of pages from authentication to database-schema
Shows edge types (supports, extends, etc.) between each pair
Shows provenance tags on each edge
Handles case where no path exists with a clear message
